resolution: 0.01 deg Merzouga - Erg Chebbi (Morocco) box (200 x 200)

sources.temperature_day: MODIS MOD11A2 LST day (~10:30 local), via Earth pipeline, degC -> K
sources.temperature_night: MODIS MOD11A2 LST night (~22:30 local), via Earth pipeline, degC -> K
sources.albedo: NASA POWER ALLSKY_SRF_ALB annual climatology (1 deg)

steps: Read atacama_unified.h5 (cleaned, QA-masked, gap-filled 0.01 deg grid from the Earth pipeline)
NASA POWER albedo: 1 deg cell value assigned to each 0.01 deg cell
notes: thermal_inertia: no Earth product yet (could be derived from albedo + LST amplitude)
mineral_index: needs an Fe abundance source; ASTER GED (silica) still not downloaded
